# form.height

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.5.7</span></div>

Get the height of the current form.

```lua
form.height()
```

## Parameters

None.

## Returns

Nothing.

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
print(form.height())
```

## Used in

- [tool-form](../../examples/official/tool-form.md)
- [widget-form](../../examples/official/widget-form.md)
